{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Identify re-tested patients (more than one sample_seq per patient)
dup_counts = df.groupby('patient_id').size()
duplicated_patients = dup_counts[dup_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple samples: {len(duplicated_patients)}")
print(f"Patients with multiple samples: {list(duplicated_patients.index)}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check assay_batch unit issue: batch B should be divided by 10
print(f"Batch A count: {(df['assay_batch'] == 'A').sum()}")
print(f"Batch B count: {(df['assay_batch'] == 'B').sum()}")

# Check severity distribution
print(f"Severity distribution:\n{df['severity'].value_counts().sort_index()}")"}
